title: Per-customer stop-sequence + sampling inheritance causing truncated completions on Dedicated/Private
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Two enterprise customers on Dedicated and one on Private reported sudden truncation of generated outputs after a runtime change that normalized sampling defaults and harmonized stop-sequence handling. Symptoms are customer-specific: some prompt templates which previously returned full completions are now cut off mid-sentence or terminate immediately. Issue appears after deploy that applied sampling_default: "nucleus=0.95,temperature=0.7" and a stop-sequence normalization sweep.

Why this ticket exists: This is a production customer escalation requiring a targeted fix and a path to prevent regressions. We need to identify the root cause (runtime vs. SDK vs. customer prompt content), mitigate for affected tenants, and ship a durable fix with tests and rollout controls.
observed_behavior: Affected completions either end immediately (0-2 tokens returned) or truncate at first control character. Errors are not raised. Issue only occurs when customer-specific prompt metadata includes an explicit stop token or includes trailing whitespace+non-printable characters in templates. Hostd customers are largely unaffected.
repro_steps: Checkout runtime-1.20 branch where sampling defaults were normalized
Deploy model with config sampling_defaults set at service-level
Use customer template with embedded '\x03' control character or trailing stop token list including empty string
Call text.generate with model-version pinned to affected variant
Observe truncated completions and no error logs referencing policy or quota
logs_and_evidence: Heap-level KV cache logs show normal CACHE-HIT rates (rules out KV corruption)
Diff of config: sampling_defaults introduced on 2026-02-28 in runtime config PR #1425
Customer repro prompt examples stored in secure drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/esc/ENG-14602-repro
triage_notes: Initial hypothesis: sampling default harmonization changed internal stop-sequence precedence. Alternative: sanitization pass removed or reinterpreted empty stop tokens, causing generator to treat first separator as termination. Priority escalated due to revenue impact for two Dedicated customers.
work_done: 03/02: Rolled temporary per-tenant override to restore previous sampling defaults (rollback flag) for the two Dedicated customers -- reduced immediate impact
03/03: Reproduced locally with customer templates and confirmed truncated outputs on same runtime image
03/04: Added additional logging around stop-sequence parsing (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1499)
03/05: Paired with SDK team to validate that SDK-level stop-seq normalization isn't conflicting (confirmed SDK passes expected lists)
03/06: Drafted fix to treat explicit empty stop tokens as no-op instead of immediate termination; added sanitizer to remove non-printable control characters from stored templates (internal PR #1504)

03/07: Created integration test cases covering: explicit empty stop token, trailing control characters, and per-tenant inherited sampling_defaults (tests added under runtime/tests/stopseq_inheritance_test.py)
03/08: Performed canary rollout of sanitizer to 5% of dedicated hosts; monitor showed no truncations for canary tenants
current_plan: 1) Merge sanitizer + empty-stop no-op logic (PR #1504). 2) Expand canary to 25% on Dedicated and 10% on Private customers overnight. 3) Run integration test suite against pinned customer templates. 4) If stable, full rollout and remove temporary per-tenant rollback flags. 5) Postmortem and docs update. Target full rollout by 2026-03-12.
rollback_and_mitigations: Temporary per-tenant sampling-default rollback implemented for two Dedicated customers on 2026-03-02. For Private customer, provided a configuration patch and assisted customer on their on-prem control plane to set sampling_default to previous value. Mitigation steps documented: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ENG-14602-mitigations
qa_and_verification: Integration tests added. QA checklist: repro prompts must return >= 90% of previously expected token length across 100 runs; no silent early terminations; logs show stop_seq parsing path names 'sanitizer' or 'legacy' as appropriate.
rollout_notes: Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. For Dedicated targets, do capacity checks because sanitizer adds minor CPU parsing cost. Notify account managers before each stage.
postmortem_actions: Add stop-sequence inheritance unit tests to CI (runtime + SDK)
Add lint in Console that warns when saved prompt templates contain non-printable characters
Document explicit tenant override semantics in ops runbook
Include sampling-default change checklist in release notes (announce changes to affected customers)
